changelog:
Initial release of Monero vs Bitcoin Comparison skill:

- Provides a comprehensive, side-by-side feature comparison of Monero and Bitcoin.
- Covers privacy, transaction speed & fees, mining, scalability, use cases, and philosophy.
- Includes technical explanations on consensus mechanisms, block structure, and privacy technologies.
- Offers guidance on choosing between Monero and Bitcoin based on user needs.
- Lists further reading resources and information for contributors.
summary: Compare Monero and Bitcoin on privacy, transaction speed, mining, scalability, use cases, and core philosophies for informed cryptocurrency choice.
